scenes.desc: Etiqueta europea alejada del tenebrismo de Scorn y cercana a lo más pulsante de The Orb («Blue Room», cuarenta minutos). Bobby Bird le da nombre desde su sello Beyond y The Higher Intelligence Agency; Andrew Weatherall le da sentido con The Sabres of Paradise: Sabresonic y Haunted Dancehall, «si fuese una película, sería Blade Runner».

podcast.title: Joining and Rejoining The Famous Flames
podcast.body: Bobby Bird was a key member of James Brown's early groups, starting with The Gospel Starlighters and evolving into The Famous Flames. He quit along with the rest of the band after the initial success of "Please Please Please" due to credit issues but rejoined "fairly shortly afterwards" and stayed with Brown for many more years, also rejoining prior to the Apollo residency after another period away. "Bobby Bird and Johnny Terry would rejoin fairly shortly afterwards, and both would stay with Brown for many more years."

podcast.title: Meeting James Brown in Detention
podcast.body: Bobby Bird met James Brown during a baseball game between inmates and outsiders at the juvenile detention center where Brown was incarcerated. Discovering Brown's singing talent and reputation as "Music Box," Bird was impressed enough to help Brown secure an early release from his sentence by speaking on his behalf at a parole hearing. "Bird got talking to Brown and discovered that he could sing."
